audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics on this page do not exist. (1) Smoke Screen is said to 'blind his Empower-buffed auto' in whys[2], early, wants.you[2] and report[10] — the W is a sight-range cut plus impact magic damage and a brief slow; Empower still lands. (2) Collateral Damage is called 'a wall-escape' and an 'R-knockback him off the all-in' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[2] — Riot's R text is damage to the first champion then a cone; the only knockback in the kit is New Destiny knocking back NON-champions.
audit.why: Both errors change how you commit: one tells you to stand in the cloud and eat an Empower auto, the other tells you to hold R as an escape button that will not move you.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen restated as sight cut plus slow everywhere; the R restated as a nuke, with the knockback correctly limited to non-champions. Counter Strike's real 17/15/13/11/9s cooldown written in as the commit trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Skill, Jax, Jax while whys[1] and whys[2] describe Levels 2-3 as your bully window, whys[3] says 4-5 tips to Jax, and whys[4] calls 6 your kill window. Packet chart is Skill, Graves, Graves, Jax, Graves, Jax, Jax.
audit.why: Four rows disagreed with the page's own text and with the packet.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Skill, Graves, Graves, Jax, Graves, Jax, Jax, Graves rows at 6/10 and the 4-5 Jax row at 3/10, with four phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as neutral filler. It is your one clean kill window, and it is gated on Counter Strike (17s at rank 1), not on your own ult.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges the entire 4-shell spread; the level-6 kill exists only inside its downtime.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now gives the 17s number and the sequence; phases[3].why names Empower's 7s rank-1 cycle as what tips 4-5 to him.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames (Counter Strike x2, Smoke Screen) are false positives — correct names in both kits.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Quickdraw online: the dash-reload weave and point-blank spread beat a Jax holding only Leap Strike.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit at 3 — dash in, fog him, and out-DPS a Jax who still needs Trinity Force to spike.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Counter Strike; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Knife-edge tipping to Jax: Empower every 7s and Leap Strike out-state True Grit as his first item lands.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 — punish that window with Q, autos and Collateral Damage for the kill.

edits.before: Full kit at 3 — Quickdraw in, Smoke-Screen-blind his auto, and the 4-shell spread out-DPS a Jax who still needs Trinity Force to spike.
edits.after: Full kit at 3 — Quickdraw in, Smoke Screen to cut his sight and slow him, and the 4-shell spread out-DPS an itemless Jax.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds a nuke and a wall-escape — punish the instant his Counter Strike stun is down and turn his Leap-Strike all-in into a kill.
edits.after: Collateral Damage adds the nuke you need — punish the 17s window while Counter Strike is down and turn his Leap-Strike all-in into a kill.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds a huge nuke and a wall-escape — punish the moment his Counter Strike stun whiffs or is on cooldown and you can turn his Leap-Strike all-in into a kill.
edits.after: Collateral Damage adds a huge nuke — punish the moment Counter Strike whiffs or sits on its 17s cooldown, and his committed Leap-Strike all-in becomes a kill. It knocks back minions, never him.

edits.before: Use Smoke Screen to blind his Empower-buffed auto and R-knockback him off the Leap Strike all-in he commits to
edits.after: Use Smoke Screen to cut his sight and slow him, then Collateral Damage the Leap Strike all-in he commits to

edits.before: Jax is even-to-behind at level 1 — he has only Leap Strike, you have one ability and your second Quickdraw charge isn't online yet, so neither of you commits cleanly. The moment he has Counter Strike, though, you can't just spray your 4-shell spread into him: the dodge eats your whole magazine and the stun lands you mid-reload. Bait that E with one shell or a feint, then commit your real point-blank burst into the empty window. Your 2-3 spike is the time to push an advantage — Quickdraw in for the True Grit armor and the auto-reset, blind his auto with Smoke Screen, and trade the spread before his items exist. Never extend a trade while he holds Counter Strike with Leap Strike up.
edits.after: Jax is even-to-behind at level 1 — he has only Leap Strike, you have one ability and your second Quickdraw charge isn't online yet, so neither of you commits cleanly. The moment he has Counter Strike, though, you can't just spray your 4-shell spread into him: the dodge eats your whole magazine and the stun lands you mid-reload. Bait that E with one shell or a feint, then commit your real point-blank burst into the 17s window. Your 2-3 spike is the time to push an advantage — Quickdraw in for the True Grit armor, fog him with Smoke Screen, and trade the spread before his items exist. Never extend a trade while he holds Counter Strike with Leap Strike up.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a knife-edge that tips his way — your stacked True Grit armor and two Quickdraw charges keep you alive, but the second his first item lands (Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King) his Empower-buffed auto and Leap Strike burst start out-stating your tank stacking. Level 6 is your one clean kill window: hold Collateral Damage for the moment his Counter Strike whiffs or its stun is on cooldown, then Q + auto + R to turn his committed Leap-Strike all-in into a corpse — and the R doubles as a wall-escape if the trade goes wrong. After that, his power only climbs.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a knife-edge that tips his way — your stacked True Grit armor and two Quickdraw charges keep you alive, but the second his first item lands (Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King) his Empower-buffed auto and Leap Strike burst start out-stating your tank stacking. Level 6 is your one clean kill window: hold Collateral Damage for the moment Counter Strike whiffs or sits on its 17s cooldown, then Q + auto + R to turn his committed Leap-Strike all-in into a corpse. Your only exit is Quickdraw, so keep a charge. After that, his power only climbs.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Two fabricated mechanics removed. Smoke Screen does not blind (sight cut plus brief slow), and Collateral Damage is not a 'wall-escape' or a champion knockback — Riot's R text is damage plus a cone, and the only knockback in Graves' kit is New Destiny against non-champions. Counter Strike's real 17s rank-1 cooldown is now the page's commit trigger, and the level chart was flipped to the packet chart the page's own whys already described. All three packet suspectNames are false positives. No mirror audit exists yet for jax__graves.
